claims.text: The trip record the driver himself relies on measures his own wait at 6.9 minutes. From that record's own arrived_at (2026-08-01T23:42:10) to its own cancelled_at (2026-08-01T23:49:05) is 415 seconds — 65 seconds short of the 480-second minimum POL-NS-01(c) requires for a trip_record.pickup_zone_class of AIRPORT. His counter-statement that he was there 'for more than eight minutes' is contradicted by the platform's own record of his trip. I disclose that this artifact is impaired: admissibility weight 0.4, issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, so its timings are discounted — but a discounted 415 seconds does not become 480 seconds, and no other artifact supplies a longer measured hold.

The driver's own GPS trace supports an in-geofence run of only 255 seconds: five consecutive qualifying fixes from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36, against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-01(c) sets — 225 seconds short. Even crediting him with the entire unobserved interval through to the 23:49:05 cancellation, the export's face-value reading is 404 seconds, still 76 seconds short, as the pre-pass notes. This artifact is impaired and I say so: weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW (228 s), GPS_GAP (186 s sitting across the moment of geofence entry), LOW_COVERAGE (22.8%), TRUNCATED_LOG (trace stops 149 s before the terminal event), LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD. The discount does not repair the shortfall — the 186-second gap that conceals the entry moment is precisely why entry cannot be credited earlier, and after 23:46:36 the trace shows no in-geofence fix at all.

The one route by which a short in-geofence run could be lengthened is closed on this record. EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no advisory covers the Changi T1 arrival kerb in this window — and its absence is itself citable. POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, so the accumulated-dwell computation is unavailable and the driver's time stands at the 255 seconds the trace records. Nothing may be added to it.

POL-NS-01(b) requires the trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence defined in POL-NS-02 at or before the timestamp of the arrived event. On the export as it stands the first qualifying in-geofence fix is stamped 23:42:21 — eleven seconds AFTER the trip record's 23:42:10 arrival event — and the trace's device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server, far over the 90-second limb in POL-NS-08(a), so on the pre-pass's own finding no fix can be safely matched to the arrival event. An arrival marker whose position at the marker cannot be verified does not satisfy limb (b), and the artifact's impairment (weight 0.25) is disclosed.

The amount in issue is the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line and nothing else. The fare breakdown is COMPLETE at weight 1.0; payment_status is PENDING and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so nothing has been returned to the rider. A full refund under POL-NS-06 moves exactly that 6.00 cancellation-fee line and no booking, platform or fare component that would only have been earned on a completed trip.

The chat export is impaired — weight 0.6, issue TRUNCATED_LOG — with messages MSG-00210-002 and MSG-00210-003 absent from the 23:42–23:49 window that the log's own sequence numbering and trip_record.chat_message_count of 4 both imply, so whatever was said between the arrival notification and the rider's protest is unavailable. I do not overreach on it: POL-NS-04 limb (a) cannot be run, because the rider's only surviving message ('why cancel?? i was at door 6') was sent at 23:49:40, after the 23:49:05 cancellation, and limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE because the trace carries no rider_track (PARTIAL_RECORD) — undecidable and neutral under POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-08(b), not adverse. What the truncated log cannot do is supply the driver the in-geofence dwell the trace fails to show.

Should the judge prefer the skew-corrected reading of the trace — which would move the first in-geofence fix to 23:38:33 server time and yield a 632-second dwell — then two admissible artifacts, EV-TRIP-00210 and EV-GPS-00210, contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell (415 s against 632 s, with the 186-second gap straddling the entry moment) and no clause resolves the conflict. The only evidence for the deciding fact is then impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b). The outcome the record supports in that event is not a ruling against the rider but escalation under POL-NS-09(b) and POL-NS-09(e), where the disputed fee is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded, so the rider is not made to carry the charge while a human reviewer settles the open question of when the driver actually entered the geofence.

This dispute is rider-filed (filed_by RIDER) and the 6.00 fee is live with refund_issued_sgd at 0.00, so under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION would leave the disputed charge exactly where it is — against the rider — and is not a neutral outcome on these facts. The only dispositions consistent with this record are a full refund under POL-NS-06 or, at the floor, escalation under POL-NS-09, which holds the fee rather than collecting it.

claims.text: fare_breakdown charges a cancellation fee of SGD 6.00 and nothing else — no base fare, no platform fee, no waiting-time fee — and SGD 6.00 is exactly what fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for this trip: the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00). POL-NS-08(d) is therefore not engaged, and this artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00 and payment_status PENDING.

POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are satisfied on the trip record: it carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip and it shows the driver terminating at 23:49:05 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. I disclose that EV-TRIP-00210 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT; that conflict concerns the arrived timestamp and the implied wait, not the existence of the arrived event or the reason code, which are internal to the record.

The proximity test in POL-NS-02 is met on the trace's own measurements: the driver's track closes to 96.0 m from the pickup pin, inside the 150 m arrival radius fee_schedule fixes for the AIRPORT zone class, and the derived arrival block counts 5 qualifying in-geofence fixes. I disclose that EV-GPS-00210 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 with issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD; the impairment goes to timing and coverage, while proximity is a measured distance rather than an inference.

The rider's shortfall case under POL-NS-06 cannot be carried by this trace. The longest continuous qualifying run the derived facts report is 255 seconds against a 480 second AIRPORT minimum, but the same artifact runs 228 seconds ahead of the server clock — far over the 90 second limb (a) threshold in POL-NS-08 — loses a 186.0 second sampling gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 straight across the moment of geofence entry, and stops 149 seconds before the cancellation. Because the deciding fact of dwell rests on a single artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b), that artifact cannot alone support a ruling against the driver, and the shortfall is not proved.

Read with the clock skew the pre-pass itself identified, the first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at 23:38:33 server time and the dwell running to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 632 seconds, comfortably past the 480 second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires. The face-value 404 seconds and the corrected 632 seconds differ only by that 228 second device skew, and the 186 second gap conceals which is right; what the artifact cannot do is affirmatively establish the shorter figure, which is the one the rider needs.

If the corrected reading governs, the fee stands and nothing from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it: the driver's fixes sit inside the AIRPORT arrival radius so POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route is not engaged, POL-NS-05 cannot be run while a 228 second skew makes the arrival marker unmatchable to any fix, and the rider's only logged message postdates the cancellation so POL-NS-04 grants no exoneration.
On that footing POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, namely SGD 4.80, with the SGD 1.20 residual retained as the platform service fee.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and compensation cannot be withheld: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 156 is 0.013, below the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs must hold, and I cite these two fields only for the test POL-NS-07 names, as POL-GEN-01 requires.

The record cannot settle this dispute, and the tribunal should say so rather than refund it. The trip record's arrived_at of 23:42:10 and its implied 6.9 minute wait cannot be reconciled with a trace whose device stamps run 228 seconds ahead and whose coverage of the entry moment is missing; POL-NS-09(b) is engaged by that direct contradiction on arrival and dwell, POL-NS-09(e) by the sole deciding artifact being impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b), and confidence is in any event capped at 0.25 by POL-GEN-02(2), below the 0.70 floor. Escalation holds the SGD 6.00 rather than refunding it, which is the correct outcome while the conflict stands.

The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 fails. The only rider message in the log is 'why cancel?? i was at door 6', sent at 23:49:40 — 35 seconds after the driver terminated the trip at 23:49:05 — so it is not a locating or coordinating message 'during the waiting window' as limb (a) requires; and limb (c) cannot be run at all, because the trace carries no rider_track, which makes the rider's position within the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius undecidable and neutral rather than established. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00210 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue code TRUNCATED_LOG, and the messages missing from that export are precisely the ones the rider would need.

POL-NS-05's false-arrival test cannot be run on this bundle, and the clause says so itself: where clock skew between the trip record and the trace exceeds 90 seconds, matching the arrival event to a GPS fix is unsafe and POL-NS-08(a) applies before POL-NS-05 can be reached. The skew here is 228 seconds, so no false-arrival finding may be entered against this driver and no such referral belongs in the ruling. I disclose that EV-GPS-00210 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 with issue code CLOCK_SKEW among others.

POL-NS-03 is not the operative clause. Its 400 m ceiling governs only where the driver was stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius; the derived distances put this driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius at qualifying fixes, so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-same-venue case and neither the limb (i) nor the limb (ii) fault allocation arises. The pickup pin also carries venue_id null, so no venue match or mismatch can be established either way.

Escalation here rests on the evidentiary conflict, not on abuse by either party: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that POL-NS-09(d) requires, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not triggered. I cite those fields only for the tests POL-NS-09 names.

ruling.explanation:
The dispute is the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider at Changi T1. The fee itself is in order: EV-FARE-00210 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee_schedule resolution rule (the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and payment_status is PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. But I cannot decide whether that fee stands or is refunded on this record, and I am sending the case to a human reviewer. The SGD 6.00 is held: not collected from the rider and not refunded.

The fee requires all four limbs of POL-NS-01. Two are satisfied on the trip record: there is a driver 'arrived' event at 23:42:10, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes limb (d) recognises. The other two limbs turn on the GPS trace, and that is where the case breaks down.

EV-GPS-00210 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a) and (b): its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (the limit is 90), and it loses a 186-second sampling gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 that sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry. Its weight is 0.25 and its issue codes are CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD. Read at face value the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 404 seconds, 76 seconds short of the 480-second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-01(c) requires. Corrected for the 228-second skew the same fix falls at 23:38:33 server time and the dwell is 632 seconds, comfortably over. The gap conceals the one fact that would choose between them, so limb (c) is undecided and limb (b) cannot be verified either, because no fix can be safely matched to the 23:42:10 arrival event.

To the rider and the driver: the SGD 6.00 no-show fee is placed on HOLD. It is neither collected from the rider nor refunded to him, while a human reviewer settles one open question. Escalation is not a win for either side.

Why no money moves today. The charge can stand only if POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. Limbs (a) and (d) are met: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes limb (d) recognises. The fee turns on limb (c): a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 480 seconds for an AIRPORT pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. The only artifact that measures that dwell is the GPS trace EV-GPS-00210, and it is broken four ways at once: its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (over the 90-second limb in POL-NS-08(a)), a 186-second sampling gap sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry, coverage is 22.8%, and the trace stops 149 seconds before the cancellation. Read at face value the qualifying run is 255 seconds (404 seconds through to cancellation), short of 480; corrected for the 228-second skew the entry is 23:38:33 and the dwell is 632 seconds, comfortably over. The gap conceals the one fact that would choose between them. Because what the test reads is impaired across the geofence-entry stretch, limb (c) is UNDECIDED, and an undecided limb supports neither the charge nor a refund.

Why escalate. The sole evidence for that deciding fact, EV-GPS-00210, is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b), which is the escalation ground in POL-NS-09(e); the trip record EV-TRIP-00210 and the trace also contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell with no clause resolving which reading is right (POL-NS-09(b)); and confidence is capped at 0.25, the GPS trace's own weight, below the 0.70 floor, which is POL-NS-09(a). On the driver's claim: the trip record measures its own 6.9-minute wait as 415 seconds from arrived_at 23:42:10 to cancelled_at 23:49:05, but that record is itself impaired (weight 0.4, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) and its timings are not the in-geofence dwell POL-NS-01(c) defines, so they cannot establish the shortfall; the driver's statement that he was there 'more than eight minutes' carries no weight, is not an admission against interest, and is not corroborated by the record he relies on. On proximity: the trace does close to 96.0 m, inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius, but proximity is not what the fee turns on and that reading comes from the same impaired trace. Compensation of SGD 4.80 (80% of SGD 6.00) cannot be entered: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and an ESCALATE ruling issues no money. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2 divided by 156 completed trips is 0.013, below 0.08), no abuse is shown on either side, and the SGD 6.00 fare-breakdown line reconciles with the fee schedule (greater of the SGD 6.00 AIRPORT zone fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

The chat log (weight 0.6, TRUNCATED_LOG, messages MSG-00210-002 and -003 missing) assists neither side: the rider's only surviving message was sent at 23:49:40, after the 23:49:05 cancellation, so POL-NS-04 limb (a) does not apply, and limb (c) is undecidable because the trace carries no rider_track - undecidable and neutral, not adverse. POL-NS-05 cannot be run while the 228-second skew makes the arrival marker unmatchable to any fix, so no false-arrival finding and no such referral is entered. The missing traffic advisory (weight 0.0) makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable. The rider has not been shown to be elsewhere, and the driver has not been shown to have waited the required 480 seconds.

Open question for the reviewer: at what time the driver entered the pickup geofence - whether the face-value reading (255-second run, short of the AIRPORT minimum) or the skew-corrected reading (632 seconds, over it) governs, and therefore whether the SGD 6.00 fee is chargeable. The reviewer has both briefs, the admissibility pre-pass report, the clause IDs relied on and this reasoning. No referral is issued because no clause in this bundle produces one.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the SGD 6.00 no-show charge for the Changi T1 pickup is placed on hold. It is neither collected from the rider nor refunded to him while a human reviewer settles one open question, and no driver compensation is paid at this stage.

Why the charge cannot be decided now. A no-show fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 480 seconds (eight minutes) for an AIRPORT pickup, counted from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix (POL-NS-01(c); fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec). The only artifact that measures that hold is the driver's GPS trace, EV-GPS-00210. It is impaired: weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW (228 s), GPS_GAP (a 186 s gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 sitting exactly across the moment of geofence entry), LOW_COVERAGE (22.8%), TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD. It is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a) (device clock 228 s ahead, over the 90 s limb) and POL-NS-08(b) (gap over 120 s inside the waiting window). Read at face value the hold runs 404 s from the 23:42:21 first fix to the 23:49:05 cancellation, 76 s short of 480; corrected for the 228 s skew the same fix falls at 23:38:33 and the hold is 632 s, comfortably over. The 186-second gap conceals precisely the fact that would choose between them. The dwell limb is therefore undecided, and an undecided limb supports neither the driver's fee (which needs the clause to hold) nor the rider's refund (which needs it to fail).

What each side argued, and why it does not decide the case. The rider's shortfall case rests on the trip record EV-TRIP-00210, whose own arrived_at (23:42:10) to cancelled_at (23:49:05) is 415 s, 65 s short. That record is itself impaired — weight 0.4, issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT — because its arrival and 6.9-minute wait cannot be reconciled with the trace; as a discounted record that contradicts the instrument it cannot break the tie, so the claimed shortfall is down-weighted rather than proved. The driver's position that POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) hold is accepted: the trip record does carry an 'arrived' event and a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination code, and those internal facts are not the ones the conflict touches. His proximity point is also accepted: the trace's track closes to 96.0 m from the pin, inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, with 5 qualifying in-geofence fixes, so POL-NS-02 is met and POL-NS-03 is not engaged (the pickup pin carries venue_id null, so no venue match or mismatch can be found either way). But proximity is not dwell, and the dwell is what is missing.

Nothing else in the bundle fills the gap. The chat log, EV-CHAT-00210, is impaired (weight 0.6, TRUNCATED_LOG), so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: her only surviving message ('why cancel?? i was at door 6', 23:49:40) postdates the cancellation, limb (a) cannot run, and limb (c) is undecidable because the trace carries no rider_track — undecidable and neutral, not adverse. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06(i) cannot sum separate in-geofence intervals. POL-NS-05 cannot be run at all: with 228 s of skew the arrival marker cannot be matched to any fix, and in any event qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, so no false-arrival finding and no false-arrival referral is entered. The fare breakdown, EV-FARE-00210, is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and settles the amount: SGD 6.00 equals the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and refund_issued_sgd of 0.00 with payment_status PENDING confirms the charge is still live.

On the driver's money. POL-NS-07 would pay him 80% of the SGD 6.00 fee, namely SGD 4.80, but only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; it is not, so no compensation issues now. The anti-farming check does not trip in any case (no_show_terminations_30d of 2, below 4; 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 156 is 0.013, below 0.08), and neither POL-NS-09(c) (disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0 for both parties) nor POL-NS-09(d) (no_show_disputes_30d of 1, below 3) is triggered — the escalation rests on the evidence problem, not on abuse by either side.

The case must be escalated. The sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b) (POL-NS-09(e)); two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell and no clause resolves the conflict (POL-NS-09(b)); and confidence is capped at 0.25 by POL-GEN-02(2), below the 0.70 floor (POL-NS-09(a)).

Open question for the reviewer: fix the driver's true geofence entry time — whether the skew-corrected 23:38:33 or the face-value 23:42:21 — and whether he then held position for the full 480 seconds. If he did, the SGD 6.00 fee stands and POL-NS-07 pays him SGD 4.80; if he did not, the SGD 6.00 is refunded to the rider under POL-NS-06.
